description_en: Queries the list of fixable vulnerabilities
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-can-fix-vul-list --type cve --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCanFixVulList

parameters.help_en:
The vulnerability type. Valid values:
cve: system vulnerability
sca: application vulnerability
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞类型。取值包括：
cve：系统漏洞
sca：应用漏洞
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The UUIDs of images. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 镜像的UUID。多个UUID使用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: uuids

parameters.help_en: The name of the vulnerability
parameters.help_zh: 漏洞的名称
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The alias in the vulnerability advisory
parameters.help_zh: 漏洞公告中的别名
parameters.name: alias_name

parameters.help_en:
The fix status of the vulnerability. Valid values:
1: Unfixed.
4: Being fixed.
7: Fixed
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞的修复状态。取值：
1：未修复
4：修复中
7：修复成功
parameters.name: status_list

parameters.help_en:
The priority levels of vulnerabilities to query. Separate multiple levels with commas (,). Valid values:

asap: high
later: medium
nntf: low
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的漏洞修复必要性等级。多个等级之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：

asap：高
later：中
nntf：低
parameters.name: necessity

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the vulnerability is handled. Valid values:

y: Handled.
n: Not handled
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞是否处理。取值：

y：已处理
n：未处理
parameters.name: dealed

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paging query. The value starts from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，显示的当前页的页码。起始值为1，默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page in a paging query. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，显示每页数据的最大条数。默认值为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the image repository. Valid values:
cn-beijing: China (Beijing)
cn-zhangjiakou: China (Zhangjiakou)
cn-hangzhou: China (Hangzhou)
cn-shanghai: China (Shanghai)
cn-shenzhen: China (Shenzhen)
cn-hongkong: Hong Kong (China)
ap-southeast-1: Singapore
ap-southeast-5: Indonesia (Jakarta)
us-east-1: US (Virginia)
us-west-1: US (Silicon Valley)
eu-central-1: Germany (Frankfurt)
eu-west-1: UK (London)
parameters.help_zh:
镜像仓库的地域ID。取值：
cn-beijing：华北2（北京）
cn-zhangjiakou：华北3（张家口）
cn-hangzhou：华东1（杭州）
cn-shanghai：华东2（上海）
cn-shenzhen：华南1（深圳）
cn-hongkong：中国香港
ap-southeast-1：新加坡
ap-southeast-5：印度尼西亚（雅加达）
us-east-1：美国（弗吉尼亚）
us-west-1：美国（硅谷）
eu-central-1：德国（法兰克福）
eu-west-1：英国（伦敦）
parameters.name: repo_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The container image instance ID.
Invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/451339.html operation of Container Registry and obtain the container image instance ID from the InstanceId response parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定容器镜像实例ID。
调用容器镜像服务的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/451339.html接口，通过返回参数**InstanceId**的值可以获取容器镜像实例ID
parameters.name: repo_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the image repository.
Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145293.html operation of Container Registry and obtain the value of the RepoId response parameter
parameters.help_zh:
镜像仓库ID。
调用容器镜像服务的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145293.html接口，通过返回参数**RepoId**的值可以获取镜像仓库ID
parameters.name: repo_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the image repository.
Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh:
镜像仓库名称。
支持模糊搜索
parameters.name: repo_name

parameters.help_en:
The namespace of the image repository.
Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh:
指定镜像仓库命名空间名称。
支持模糊查询
parameters.name: repo_namespace

parameters.help_zh: 容器镜像的标签

The ID of the container cluster.

The scan scope. Valid values:

image: Image.
container: Container

扫描范围。取值：

image：镜像。
container：容器
parameters.name: scan_range

parameters.name: cluster_name

parameters.help_en: The container ID
parameters.help_zh: 容器ID
parameters.name: container_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the pod
parameters.help_zh: 容器组名称
parameters.name: pod

The cluster namespace.

parameters.help_zh: The ResourceDirectoryAccountId

CanFix.description_en:
Indicates whether the vulnerability can be fixed in the console. Valid values:

yes: Fixable.
no: Not fixable
CanFix.description_zh:
是否可控制台修复。取值：

yes：可修复
no：不可修复

CanUpdate.description_en:
Specifies whether the software package that causes the vulnerability can be upgraded through Security Center. Valid values:

true: Supported.
false: Not supported
CanUpdate.description_zh:
导致漏洞的软件包是否支持通过云安全中心升级。取值：

true：支持升级
false：不支持升级

ExtendContentJson.description_en: The extended content of the vulnerability information

Os.description_en: The name of the operating system

OsRelease.description_en: The release version of the operating system corresponding to the container image
OsRelease.description_zh: 容器镜像对应的操作系统发行的版本

FullVersion.description_en: The full version number of the software package

Layer.description_en: The SHA256 value of the container image layer digest
Layer.description_zh: 容器镜像层级的摘要的SHA256值

MatchDetail.description_en: The detailed information about the vulnerability match

Name.description_en: The name of the software package

Path.description_en: The path of the software that contains the vulnerability
Path.description_zh: 存在漏洞的软件所在路径

UpdateCmd.description_en: The command used to fix the vulnerability

Version.description_en: The version number of the software package

FirstTs.description_en: The timestamp when the vulnerability was first detected, in milliseconds
FirstTs.description_zh: 首次发现漏洞的时间戳，单位为毫秒

ImageDigest.description_en: The unique identifier of the container image

InstanceName.description_en:
The instance name.

The name must be 3 to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
InstanceName.description_zh:
实例名称。

长度限制3~64个字符，可以是中文、英文、数字、短划线（-）以及下划线（_）

InternetIp.description_en: The public IP address of the asset

IntranetIp.description_en: The private IP address of the asset

LastTs.description_en: The timestamp when the vulnerability was last detected, in milliseconds
LastTs.description_zh: 最后发现漏洞的时间戳，单位为毫秒

Layers.description_en: The list of container image layers

items.description_en: The list of container image layers

MaliciousSource.description_en:
The source of the malicious file. Valid values:

agentless: Agentless detection.
image: Image.
container: Container
MaliciousSource.description_zh:
恶意文件来源。取值：

agentless：无代理检测
image：镜像
container：容器

ModifyTs.description_en: The timestamp when the vulnerability status was modified, in milliseconds
ModifyTs.description_zh: 修改漏洞状态时间戳，单位为毫秒

Necessity.description_en:
The priority level of the vulnerability fix. Valid values:

asap: High.
later: Medium.
nntf: Low.

Fix vulnerabilities with the High priority level as soon as possible
Necessity.description_zh:
漏洞修复必要性等级。取值：

asap：高
later：中
nntf：低

建议您尽快修复必要性等级为高的漏洞

Related.description_en: The list of CVEs associated with the vulnerability. Multiple values are separated by commas (,)
Related.description_zh: 漏洞关联的CVE列表，有多个取值时用半角逗号（,）分隔

RepoName.description_en: The name of the container image repository

RepoNamespace.description_en: The namespace of the container image repository
RepoNamespace.description_zh: 容器镜像仓库的命名空间

ScanTime.description_en: The timestamp of the scan, in milliseconds
ScanTime.description_zh: 扫描的时间戳，单位：毫秒

Status.description_en:
The fix status of the vulnerability. Valid values:
1: Unfixed.
4: Being fixed.
7: Fixed
Status.description_zh:
漏洞的修复状态。取值：
1：未修复
4：修复中
7：修复成功

Tag.description_en: The tag of the container image

TargetId.description_en: The ID of the scan target

TargetName.description_en: The name of the scan target

TargetType.description_en:
The object type of the scan target. Valid values:

IMAGE: Container image.
ECS_IMAGE: Host image.
ECS_SNAPSHOT: Snapshot
TargetType.description_zh:
扫描对象类型。取值：

IMAGE：容器镜像。
ECS_IMAGE：主机镜像。
ECS_SNAPSHOT：快照

Type.description_en:
The vulnerability type. Valid values:
cve: system vulnerability
sca: application vulnerability
Type.description_zh:
漏洞类型。取值包括：
cve：系统漏洞
sca：应用漏洞
